title: Among users from New York who have earned either a 'Teacher' or 'Supporter'
question: Among users from New York who have earned either a 'Teacher' or 'Supporter' badge, find those who posted comments containing a URL and whose total post view count exceeds 10,000. Return their display names and the sum of their post view counts without duplicate.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_055" AS DisplayName, SUM(T3."XCL_030") AS TotalViewCount
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1."XCL_052" = T2."XCL_002"
INNER JOIN comments AS T4 ON T1."XCL_052" = T4."XCL_010"
INNER JOIN posts AS T3 ON T4."XCL_006" = T3."XCL_026"
WHERE T1."XCL_058" = 'New York'
  AND T2."XCL_003" IN ('Teacher', 'Supporter')
  AND T4."XCL_008" LIKE '%http%'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_052"
HAVING SUM(T3."XCL_030") > 10000
